# Equal Parts Secures $23M in Funding to Transform Independent Insurance With Blend of AI Tools and Human Relationships
...
Series A investment will enable the company to expand footprint, enhance purpose-built platform and target $1B in premiums by 2028
...
AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Equal Parts, an insurance platform focused on transforming independent agencies, today announced it has raised $23M in Series A funding led by Inspired Capital. The investment will enable the company to accelerate its mission to acquire independent agencies and equip them with AI tools that extend their reach and increase their impact.
...
The Series A funding from Inspired, with participation from Equal Ventures, Max Ventures, Genius Ventures, and lending partners, brings Equal Parts’ total acquisition capital raised to $50M. Recent acquisitions include Strategic Insurance in New Mexico and the Austin-based agencies Assurely and Lumen Insurance.

# Exclusive: Equal Parts raises $23M for insurance rollup play

- Ryan Lawler

Feb 10, 2026

Illustration: Aïda Amer/Axios

Equal Parts, which is buying insurance agencies and moving them to an in-house operating system, raised $23 million in Series A funding, CEO Mike Witte tells Axios exclusively.

Why it matters: Half of agency principals say their firm will see a major ownership change in the next 10 years, according to Liberty Mutual research.

# Equal Parts raises $23 million in Inspired Capital-led Series A
...
Artificial intelligence-focused broker consolidator Equal Parts has raised $23 million in a Series A funding round led by Inspired Capital.
...
The funding round, which included participation from Equal Ventures, Max Ventures, Genius Ventures and lending partners, brings Equal Parts' total acquisition capital raised to $50 million.
...
The Austin-based company said the funding will help it acquire independent agencies and equip them with AI tools intended to expand their reach and improve performance.
...
Since its launch in March 2025 with $10 million of acquisition capital, Equal Parts said that it has increased revenue growth for its acquired agencies by nearly 40% and delivered bottom-line improvement by almost 50%.
...
The Mike Witte-led company said it is targeting the acquisition of 25 agencies this year and aims to reach $1 billion in premiums within 24 months.

Equal Parts, an InsurTech platform focused on transforming independent insurance agencies through acquisition and technology, has raised $23m in fresh funding as it looks to scale rapidly across the US market.
...
The Series A round was led by Inspired Capital, with participation from Equal Ventures, Max Ventures, Genius Ventures and a group of lending partners.
...
The funding will support the company’s efforts to expand its footprint among independent agencies and strengthen its technology-driven operating model.
...
The newly raised capital will be used to accelerate the acquisition of independent agencies and to further develop the platform’s AI capabilities. Equal Parts said these investments are intended to extend the reach of its acquired agencies, increase operational efficiency and deliver stronger financial performance.
...

Half the industry is retiring in the next decade. We allow owners to exit without sacrificing their agency’s culture, autonomy or client-focused values. Instead, we carry their legacies forward in a new way, with equal parts technology and tradition.”
